description.value:
You kept the holonet running, whether on the payroll of a corporation, a government, or a syndicate that preferred its work stay off the books. That access meant you saw more of the traffic passing through the network than you were ever supposed to.

You still hold the codes to at least one distributor station, and tuning in on the right day can turn up information nobody meant to broadcast that widely.

toolProficiencies: Choose two from mechanic's kit, security kit, and slicer's kit
system.equipment: A set of common clothes, an old transceiver antenna, two tools of your choice, and a belt pouch containing 50 credits.
